bluf: Human Level is a Spanish SEO and AI visibility agency selling to enterprise brands, with every service relabelled SEO/GEO and a dedicated line for findability in AI assistants. The record shows a research led house: two published SEO books, a triple nomination at the European Search Awards 2026 and an ICANN funded geoTLD study. The one thing a rival should know: it sells AI visibility while publishing no llms.txt, names only 1 client on record, and the Horus read puts it Favored at 25.2 with the hollowed out agency middle (KJ6) as its exposure, so it is likely contestable on proof.
doing:
Human Level positions itself as an SEO and AI visibility (GEO) agency that solves complex technical search problems and makes brands findable across search engines, AI assistants, YouTube and app stores: in plain words, technical SEO consultancy renamed around findability wherever an answer is generated. Its headline claim is that it is the SEO and AI agency chosen by major national and international brands, backed by twenty years of experience; the record names only one brand.

The mix is twelve services, from audit, technical and content SEO/GEO through migrations, WPO, international and local to GEO in AIs, ASO, YouTube and digital PR. Two lines lead at a score of 3. AI Search / GEO rests on a meta that pitches an SEO and AI agency, every service framed SEO/GEO, a GEO in AIs line and 20 AI search URLs. SEO rests on a title reading Agencia SEO and the breadth of the SEO/GEO nav. Content & Digital PR scores 2 on digital PR and content lines and two published SEO books, SEO Técnico and SEO avanzado. Proprietary assets are the Encontrables newsletter and a findability framework of three layers and five pillars from an R&D talk at Innova Bilbao; no partner is listed.

Its AI posture is to sell AI as findability, with a steady stream of ChatGPT and AI Mode analysis; AI Automation / Agents scores 0.

Moves in date order: 2025-12, the CIEGE certificate for business management excellence and an ICANN funded international study on geoTLD domain visibility; 2026-04, the triple nomination at the European Search Awards 2026 and a news post claiming recognition as an SEO/GEO leader in Spain and Europe, awarding body not shown. Pricing: the homepage meta invites quote requests and no prices are shown. Absent: no case study, no jobs, no partner badge, no office beyond the country, and paid, web, CRM and measurement lines at 0 or 1.
clients:
The record marks its client type as enterprise and lists eight verticals: ecommerce, online media, banking and insurance, travel and leisure, healthcare, education, B2B and energy. The home market is Spain and the region Europe; the site runs in Spanish, English, French and Portuguese, and no office is listed.

The book holds 1 client and it is a name only: Signify, from a testimonial on the homepage, with no described work, so its need is inferred from what the agency leads with, organic demand and AI visibility, and the record does not say which. Every other reference to major national and international brands is a claim without a name.

No client on record sits on another tracked agency's book, which follows from a one name book rather than a checked overlap.

What the base needs next is a judgment tied to the edition. KJ1 (the click is being replaced by the citation) is the judgment it is best placed for, driven by AI Search / GEO and Content & Digital PR, so it is likely, with moderate confidence, that the enterprise brands it serves ask for AI citation share and measured findability next, a need its GEO in AIs line already names. KJ6 (the agency middle is being hollowed out) is its exposure, driven by SEO and Content & Digital PR, so it is a roughly even chance that the technical SEO hours those brands buy are the ones squeezed first, and KJ9 (measurement gets worse before it gets better) adds that the proof will be harder to show while no audited AI visibility product is on record. With one name on the book, all of this is inferred from the sold mix.
house: The record marks 1 of 2 say and do lines practised and house integrity at 50. AI Search / GEO is contradicted, and it is the one gap the Radar lists: it sells AI visibility and publishes no llms.txt while its sitemap holds 20 AI topic URLs; no AI crawlers are blocked. Publishing cadence is corroborated by 8 sitemap URLs updated in 90 days and 73 in 365 out of 1437, on a site the record credits with 574 blog posts. The tag stack is gtm alone on WordPress, with no social pixel, test tool or ABM stack detected. Google's ad transparency status is blocked, so its own Google advertising could not be checked. LinkedIn's ad library returned not found: 3 ads match the name query and none is a company page ad. No Meta or TikTok check is recorded. The social links are LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube and Bluesky.
market:
The Horus read puts Human Level at a tailwind index of 25.2, band Favored. It is best placed for KJ1 (the click is being replaced by the citation) at net 0.438, driven by AI Search / GEO and Content & Digital PR, and for KJ2 at 0.263; it is most exposed to KJ6 (the agency middle is being hollowed out) at -0.27, driven by SEO and Content & Digital PR, and to KJ9 at -0.087. The best scenario fit is The Toll Road at 65/100. It is partial on P1 (audited AI visibility) and P7 (owned audience hedges, the newsletter); P2, P3 and P6 are absent; P5 is unknown; P4 and P8 do not apply.

The Monsoon read is 63.0, band Onshore wind, migration 65.5 against displacement 60.5, inferred, the enterprise ICP term pulling it down. 66 of the index is the sold mix, SEO (27) and AI Search / GEO (14) most movable; the shore split sends 60% to Latin America and 20% to South and Southeast Asia, No hub office or onshore claim is listed.
openings:
The strongest opening is proof. It sells AI visibility, publishes no llms.txt across 20 AI topic URLs, and P1 is partial with no audited product in the record, so it is likely, with moderate confidence, that a rival opening with an audited AI citation number wins the GEO conversation against evidence made of books, talks and nominations. The falsifier is a captured page showing a tracked AI visibility product with a number.

The gap to lead with is the book: 1 client on record, Signify, with no described work, against a headline claim of major national and international brands, so a rival with named enterprise cases in banking, ecommerce or travel is likely believed first. P2 is absent, so the feed, schema and entity layer answer engines consume is unclaimed under its own GEO line, and P5 is unknown, so a transparent outcome priced offer is a conversation it cannot have in public.

The judgment exposure is KJ6: its SEO and content hours are the ones the hollowed out middle removes, and the Monsoon read sends 60% of the movable hours to Latin America, so a Spanish speaking offshore delivered rival can undercut the technical SEO line, an inferred read.
watch: Indicator I2, Alphabet Q3 2026 search growth and AI Mode ad disclosures, next reading late October 2026: growth below 10% flags cannibalization of its SEO line, while above 15% with AI Mode ads live confirms S1 and its GEO tailwind.

Indicator I10, Reddit US daily users against search referral volatility, next reading late October 2026: US DAUq growth at or below 5% alongside AI Mode growth confirms the UGC starvation risk behind KJ1.

Indicator I8, holdco Q3 organic growth, headcount and pricing model disclosures, next reading October 2026: output or outcome pricing announced at a top five holdco would sharpen its KJ6 exposure while its own pricing stays a quote request.
Indicator I3, OpenAI ad run rate disclosures and CPM trend, rolling: the $2B milestone and pricing below $20 CPM would tell whether its KJ2 tailwind reaches a shop with no paid line.

Follow up the dated moves: the ICANN funded geoTLD study announced 2025-12 and the European Search Awards 2026 nomination of 2026-04 are the record's proof points, so a published study result or an award result would change the proof reading.
The next Radar compile refreshes offices, ads, sitemap cadence and clients; this dossier is only as fresh as the 2026-09-28 compile.
